title: Candlesticks
caption:
Every chart is made of these. Here's how to read one.

Each candle shows four prices: the open, the close, the high and the low. The body runs from open to close, and the wicks show the extremes. Green closed higher, red closed lower.

Together, they tell a story. A long upper wick means buyers pushed up, and sellers pushed it back.

Practise reading candles at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

narration: Every chart is made of these. Here's how to read a candle. Each candle shows four prices. Where it opened, where it closed, the highest point and the lowest point. The thick part is the body, and the thin lines are the wicks. A green candle closed higher than it opened. A red one closed lower. Read together, they tell a story. This one says buyers pushed price up, but sellers pushed it most of the way back. A long upper wick like that is a sign of rejection from above. Practise reading candles at memestreet.net.
